cases.name: no-manifest
cases.message: holds no workspace.yaml: a product is recognised by its manifest

cases.name: empty-manifest
cases.message: is empty: a product is recognised by its schemaVersion

cases.name: not-a-mapping
cases.message: a manifest is a mapping of fields, and this is not one

cases.name: anchor
cases.message: writes the anchor "&same

cases.name: alias
cases.message: writes the alias "*same

cases.name: alias-for-a-field
cases.message: stands the alias "*same" in a mapping key's place

cases.name: tag
cases.message: writes the tag "!!str

cases.name: flow-collection
cases.text:
schemaVersion: 1
id: 8f2c1d4e-5a6b-4c7d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f

cases.message: fields are block mappings and block sequences of mappings

cases.name: second-document
cases.message: opens another document on line 4: a manifest is one document

cases.name: duplicate-field
cases.message: names "schemaVersion" twice, again on line 2: each field is given once

cases.name: tab-indent
cases.message: indents with a tab on line 2: a manifest is indented with spaces
